definitions.explanation: Parents who have legally adopted a child, or parents who are raising a child that is not their biological offspring.

examples.japanese: {養父母|ようふぼ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てられた→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧。
examples.english: I was raised by adoptive parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{養父母|ようふぼ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{慕|した}っている→慕う：09912_shitau⟧。
examples.english: She loves her adoptive parents as if they were her biological parents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幼|おさな}い→幼い：02337_osanai⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{養父母|ようふぼ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{取|と}られ→引き取る：06164_hikitoru⟧、⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧{深|ぶか}く⟦{育|そだ}てて→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感謝|かんしゃ}している→感謝する：06055_kanshasuru⟧。
examples.english: I was taken in by my adoptive parents as a young child and am grateful for being raised with deep love.

notes:
A compound of {養|よう} (to foster, to adopt) and ⟦{父母|ふぼ}→父母：03988_fubo⟧ (father and mother). The individual terms are ⟦{養父|ようふ}→養父：17834_youfu⟧ (adoptive father) and ⟦{養母|ようぼ}→養母：21105_youbo⟧ (adoptive mother).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {養父母|ようふぼ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てられる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to be raised by adoptive parents
- {養父母|ようふぼ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{暮|く}らす→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧: to live with one's adoptive parents
- {養父母|ようふぼ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to look for adoptive parents

RELATED WORDS:
- {実父母|じつふぼ}: biological parents — the birth parents
- ⟦{里親|さとおや}→里親：21054_satooya⟧: foster parent — specifically a foster care parent, which may be temporary
- ⟦{養子|ようし}→養子：14626_youshi⟧: adopted child
- {養子縁組|ようしえんぐみ}: legal adoption
